correctness.rationale: TARGET route: checked model (E1)-(E3),(D), scales (1)-(6), limit (7)-(11) and proof Steps 0-5. LD input is displacement-only so importing DG Thm 5.1 verbatim with m^n->exp(L_n(Y)) is legitimate; quenched trimming bounds B/A/C use only R(eps_n)~eps^r L_n and displacement lemmas and hold a.s. since L_n/n->mu; decoupling with deterministic k_n,l_n holds a.s. for same reason. Step 3 reversal identity (L_n-L_{n-j},descendant law)=d(L^<-_j,Z^<-_j) is exact by i.i.d. stationarity with exact independence from early bulk; upsilon in (0,infty) a.s. since j=0 term is 1 and sum<=sum exp(-L^<-_j)<infty; void-probability gives (11). Tail DCT sketch is standard and uses a.s. summability; no fatal gap found. Computed artifact reproduced (Part A matches sigma*sqrt(n); Part B single-jump) and draft explicitly labels it support, not proof.

originality.rationale: Fused search over literal, equivalent (Weibull/stretched-exponential/semiexponential/Gumbel-domain), and dominance (BRW in BPRE/census/database) directions returned DG homogeneous Weibull extremal process and Bhattacharya-Palmowski regularly-varying BPRE extremes as nearest priors. Full-text theorem-scope inspection shows DG assumes deterministic GW mean m>1 with d_n from n log m and deterministic m^{-j} decoration and no environment/reversal, while BP assumes regularly-varying tails with Frechet/SScDPP limit and states the light-tailed analog is not yet known. No source states or implies Weibull-BPRE Cox limit with Y-dependent b_n(Y) and Y^<-reversed decoration; combination is not mechanical because r>2/3 precise LD beyond one-big-jump plus random d_n(Y)/Psi_n/tau_n and uniform trimming are required.

value.rationale: TARGET match: admitted target asked for explicit environment-dependent centring b_n(Y) and vague limit conditional on survival with Cox decoration and time-reversed-environment dependence; draft delivers d_n(Y),a_n(Y),b_n(Y)=d_n+tau_n covering full 0<r<1 including r=2/3 transition, Cox cluster (7)-(9) with upsilon(Y^<-),W,T_k, and Y^<--mixture Gumbel maximum (11), plus proof that deterministic centring diverges as sigma*sqrt(n) and quenched fixed limit is impossible. This is a recognized DG+BPRE question with pre-existing motivation, not a textbook restatement, mere m^n->exp(L_n) substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration; a future researcher needs the exact random centring and reversed decoration.
